trends.whatProductOffers: Pays a monthly benefit equal to 1% of the sum assured from the 7th month of continuing total and permanent disability, for up to 100 months, after the disability has persisted for 6 consecutive months.

keyFigures.label: Qualifying period
keyFigures.condition: Disability must arise within 180 days of the accident

exclusionsOrConditions: Only total and permanent disability qualifies, not partial or temporary disability.
The disability must occur within 180 days of the accident and persist for 6 consecutive months.
No PTD benefit is paid if the Accidental Death & Dismemberment Benefit has been paid for the same accident, and vice versa.
The sum assured and premium are reduced after a PTD or AD&D payment.
clientSignalPhrases: wants monthly income not lump sum
clientProfileFit: Families needing income continuity after an accident

trends.whatProductOffers: Pays a HK$/MOP500,000 accidental death and dismemberment benefit if a covered injury occurs within 180 consecutive days of the accident, plus a HK$/MOP5,000 compassionate death benefit to the beneficiary.
exclusionsOrConditions: The AD&D benefit requires the injury to occur within 180 consecutive days of the accident.
The plan covers accidents, not illness.
The captured text does not make clear whether the Compassionate Death Benefit is accident-only or payable on any death.
Outstanding amounts owed to AIA are deducted before payment.
clientProfileFit: Clients topping up existing life cover
trends.talkingPointTemplate: For {client_detail}, an accident that kills or dismembers pays HK$/MOP500,000, with a further HK$/MOP5,000 compassionate death benefit.
verificationPrompts: Confirm the client's dependants and mortgage balance
Check whether existing life cover already covers accidental death

sourceEvidence: If the worst should happen and the insured passes away, we will pay the beneficiary the Compassionate Death Benefit in a lump sum.
